capabilities: edit LaTeX formulas in a WYSIWYG MathLive editor with source-mode toggle
search and insert formulas from a 2,216-entry built-in library with usage-frequency sorting
fill parameterized templates and paste spreadsheet rows as matrix LaTeX
plot y = f(x) with parameter sliders and insert or export the figure as SVG
edit Mermaid diagrams visually with templates and export SVG
disambiguation: Not just a browsable reference list of formulas; it also edits, converts, plots, and inserts them.
extras: AGPL-3.0-only since 1.6.3 (MIT through 1.5.0); conversion is bundled as a pinned Core WASM binary with detailed privacy and security disclosures; installable manually or via BRAT; ASCII formula inputs require 1.6.3+.
problem: Obsidian renders LaTeX and Mermaid but offers no WYSIWYG formula editing, no reusable formula library, and no visual diagram or function-plotting tools, so users write notation by hand and hunt for snippets.

relations.evidence: The mathematical editor and diagram features rely on MathLive and Obsidian's rendering environment.
When Excalidraw is installed, the toolbar exposes a shortcut for freehand and drag-and-drop drawing
Formula library extracted from LaTeXSnipper Office Plugin
copied as standalone MathML for Word's own importer

summary: Visual LaTeX formula editor with a searchable library of 2,216 formulas, parameterized templates, matrix pasting, function plotting, and Mermaid diagram editing.
